title: Idea pipeline: research digest, weekly trends, idea synthesis into Proposals (L)
description:
Scheduled jobs that turn research into story ideas filed as Proposals. This subsumes the trend story pipeline (PPY-fb4dfa). Smallest first version: the daily digest and the idea-synthesis job filing story_draft Proposals with a fixed ideas-per-week limit; weekly trends and section quotas follow once the first Proposals have been judged.

Scope:
- A daily digest of newly accepted research, grouped by cluster and entity.
- Weekly trends from the knowledge history archive (rising clusters, new concepts, momentum), run after the knowledge run.
- Idea synthesis that reads the digest, the trends and existing published or in-flight stories (using the similarity index when available), and files story_draft Proposals with cited signals and a novelty reason.
- Site knobs: ideas per week, section quotas, priority for uncovered sections.
- An approved idea becomes a story in its first state, which triggers the story-state triggers story.
- All three are automations on the run contract, outputs to review by default.

Acceptance criteria:
- The digest, trends and synthesis jobs run on schedule as automations and record runs.
- Each filed Proposal cites its signals and gives a novelty reason; the weekly limit and section quotas are honoured.
- Approving a story_draft Proposal creates a story in its first state.
- Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) required.

Depends on the human review points story, the story-state triggers story and the automation records story (PPY-2e6e2b). PPY-fb4dfa is folded into this story.

comments.text: v0 status: digest plus synthesis merged (#641); soft-review wiring and steering read-back merged (#651, in the next release). Tried locally on TI (3 ideas, $0.003) and Anth.us (3 ideas, $0.002); ideas are in ~/Projects/shipped-handover-20261022/ideas-v0-*.md. Key finding: monitors deliver references as pending (Anth.us: 0 accepted / 10 pending; TI: 11 / 1,076), so accepted-only runs have no input. Next: an auto-accept or soft-review policy for pending references, then scheduling via automations, a service identity that can file Proposals, weekly trends and embedding-based dedupe. Proposals are now private by default (proposals.publish opt-in).
